title: Improved Confidence Intervals for Expectiles
content: This paper is concerned with the derivation of the Edgeworth expansion for the standardized and the studentized version of the kernel-based estimator of the expectile. Inverting the expansion allows us to construct accurate confidence intervals for the expectile. The theoretical asymptotic results are applied for moderate sample sizes. The methodology is illustrated with an application in risk management in finance for the estimation and accurate confidence interval construction for the coherent risk measure expectile-VaR.
